comments.author: qwerty-sonic
comments.body:
I've got a problem. I built a trailer for my game Minefield Mayhem using Openshot. it's a simple gameplay trailer. I'm not a great video editor, but I have some experience with simple videos so I'm not upset with it. However for fun I asked an AI to play my game and build me a trailer just to see if it could do it. The problem is that I think I like it better than mine. Do I use the AI generated trailer because it's more professional or do I go with my trailer I made because AI bad?

Here's the two trailers for reference. The first (also embedded) trailer is my creation. The second is the AI trailer:  
[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Znb3fF98kzI](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Znb3fF98kzI)  
[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sVfPKo7n3Nc](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sVfPKo7n3Nc)
